title: "Recalculated data used" is incorrect; "Calculated data used" is the apparent intention.
symptom: AAPS reports 'recalculated data used' (warning triangle above BG) but the user believes it actually means it calculated new data because old data was out of date, which is confusing.
cause: The original data was not in 5 min interval and AAPS approximated (recalculated) new data that matches the 5 min interval. It has nothing to do with the age of data.
evidence_quote: No. It means that original data was not in 5 min interval and AAPS approximated (recalculated) new data that match  5 min interval. It has nothing to do with the aga of data
